status: Environment repairs validated for Leon and Hermes; OpenClaw has hosted search declared but a native tool routing failure. Prior scored attempts still require impact audit and compromised-slot replacement.

changes.openclaw: Enable documented native ChatGPT Responses hosted search opt-in.
changes.hermes: Pin native subscription hosted search and keyless Keenable extraction.
changes.leon: Start the native authenticated Core HTTP service, generate trial profile credentials with the native setup helper, connect a trial-owned Chromium profile, and align the parent process working directory. Native tool worker directory behavior is preserved.
changes.grading: Translate preserved Leon trajectory events into the native grader compatibility transcript.
changes.browser: Provide the same read-only full Chromium executable to all agents; profiles remain per trial.
changes.reporting: Expose publication validation status in report exports.
changes.dependencies: Read-only alias of the private Leon snapshot resolves installed console scripts without modifying their native packages or mounting the owner repository.

publication_status: Preliminary WildClawBench ranking on valid matched tasks across all six domains. Unresolved fixture, capability, task-guide, and grading exclusions remain; results are not a certified final leaderboard. PinchBench and Terminal-Bench are not yet scored.
native_behavior_preserved: Tool worker source-directory default is a native Leon behavior; no tool arguments or source code are overridden.
Hermes client-side calls to a server-only search backend remain native failures.

dependency_path_aliases.purpose: Resolve frozen virtualenv console script shebangs against the same private dependency snapshot.

validation.runner_eslint: passed for Wild/Terminal and Pinch runner copies in their native import layout
validation.native_browser_console: passed with private snapshot alias; container removed

observed_native_agent_limitations.openclaw: Configured V2 preflight receives hosted web_search but asks tool_call for an unregistered web_search id. Browser succeeds. This is retained as native agent behavior, not another missing enablement setting.
observed_native_agent_limitations.hermes: V2 native hosted search and browser both succeed. Earlier execute_code client calls to the server-only provider were native routing errors.
